About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Ping Identity is looking for a proactive Senior Field Marketing Manager to join the UKI region. This team has gone through a restructure in 2025 and while has the largest customer base in EMEA ,the objective is to drive geo growth in 2H 2026 and beyond.  There is considerable effort needed to boost brand awareness and create net new logo demand to achieve the regions' ambitious growth targets. 

This individual will be responsible for the UKI region, alongside a UKI Field Marketing Specialist. This innovative and forward-thinking marketing professional will partner closely with the UKI Sales leaders and Sales organisation and work with pan-EMEA Go To Market (GTM) teams to develop and implement a strategic integrated GTM plan, focusing on multi-touch campaigns that drive qualified pipeline.

Duty and Responsibilities:

  • Jointly work as part of the UKI leadership team and the Senior Manager Field Marketing for Northern Europe to develop the strategic approach required for success in region to drive exceptional growth
  • Work with internal parties and third-party vendors to develop and achieve our Go To Market vision in region
  • Execute the UKI plan with clear focus on delivering the metrics of success
  • Manage the day to day activity of the Field Marketing Specialist, ensuring growth and development
  • Review, refine and develop the GTM tactics on a regular basis to ensure continued engagement and penetration into the named strategic accounts
  • Work with the Pan-EMEA Programmes lead to create and execute vertical or use case led GTM plans for Account Executives to an enterprise audience (ABM 1:Few, 1:1, Deal acceleration programmes,)
  • Provide articulate feedback on the campaigns, analysis of success and next steps
  • Participate to the quarterly QBRs reporting on successes and outlining future strategies and tactics
  • Responsible for budget and procurement processes, auditing and accountability for budget spend and management

 

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or in a related field.
  • A minimum of 2-3 years' experience in Senior Field Marketing role
  • Previous experience in the IT industry, ideally in a technology B2B SAAS environment
  • Knowledge of current digital marketing technologies and techniques.
  • Working knowledge of SFDC and Marketo.
  • Great relationship building and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Positive attitude and work collaboratively. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong initiative and ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Qualifications:

  • A marketing or related business degree or equivalent

Working Conditions:

  • Travel – approximately 30% travel, mostly within the UKI region but some within Europe or US
  • Remote working contract with occasional travel to our London and Bristol based offices to work alongside the regional Sales Development Reps

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

data.description:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Senior/Staff Product Engineer for our Cards team in London. You’ll own problems end-to-end across our payments infrastructure: tokenisation, card network integrations, 3DS and dispute management. That runs from customer conversations, through API design, to production code and measuring whether it worked. You’ll lead by example: mentoring, raising the bar and owning technical direction, staying hands-on the whole time.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building core payments infrastructure, including tokenisation, network integrations, 3DS and dispute management

  • Designing developer-facing APIs, SDKs and primitives that developers enjoy using

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a box. It's part legal tech specialist, part product expert, part solutions architect, and part trusted advisor. If you want a role that stays static, this isn't it.

Your mission is to help some of the world's leading law firms get the absolute most out of Legora. You'll understand how lawyers work, how firms operate, and where AI can make the biggest difference — then turn that potential into workflows that deliver real value.

You'll be the person clients call when they want to rethink how legal work gets done — whether that's transforming how a practice group delivers work, embedding Legora across an international firm, or helping partners build the case for AI adoption.

Specifically, you will

  • Act as a genuine thought partner to law firms — understanding their practice areas, commercial priorities and ways of working, then identifying high-value opportunities to transform how legal services are delivered.

  • Own the journey alongside Customer Success from early pilots through onboarding to firm-wide adoption, turning initial use cases into sustained, measurable impact across teams, offices and practice groups.

  • Design and implement workflows around the realities of private practice — from due diligence, contract review and drafting to litigation, regulatory advisory, transactions and knowledge management.

  • Partner with law firm partners, innovation leaders, knowledge teams and practising lawyers to build the case for AI adoption, connecting Legora's capabilities to outcomes that matter to the firm and its clients.

  • Be the voice of the private practice lawyer inside Legora — bringing a deep understanding of legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial realities of law firms into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic direction.

  • Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from associates and partners to firm leadership.

  • Help firms navigate one of the most significant shifts in legal service delivery — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal work is performed, priced and delivered to clients.

  • Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora partners with leading law firms as we grow globally.

What you'll bring

You've worked in private practice and understand the reality of delivering legal advice in a law firm. You know that great legal work isn't just about getting the right answer — it's about delivering exceptional quality under pressure, managing demanding clients, exercising sound judgement and balancing commercial expectations with the highest professional standards.

But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how law firms operate and deliver value to their clients.

We're looking for

  • Meaningful experience working within a law firm, giving you a strong understanding of private practice, legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial pressures of delivering legal services.

  • Strong legal judgement and credibility. A legal qualification is valuable, but we're ultimately interested in your ability to understand sophisticated legal work and how it can be transformed.

  • Tech-curious and product-savvy — not necessarily a coder, but someone who leans into technical conversations around generative AI, implementation and workflow transformation.

  • Commercially minded — you understand how law firms operate and can connect changes in legal workflows to outcomes that matter to partners, practice groups and their clients.

  • A natural translator — comfortable moving between practising lawyers, partners, innovation and knowledge teams, product teams and engineers.

  • Someone who brings structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity — the calm, credible presence clients rely on when they're navigating significant change.

  • Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple complex client relationships without losing quality or pace.

  • High standards without perfectionism — you ship, you learn, and you make it better over time.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity:

We’re looking for an exceptional commercial lawyer to join our lean, high-impact legal team as our second commercial lawyer. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of law and business strategy — a deal-maker with sharp instincts, sound judgment, and genuine excitement about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech.

Our legal team has a real seat at the table. You’ll close deals that matter, shape legal strategy at the frontier of AI, and craft commercial frameworks that are being built for the first time in this space. You’ll also help establish a legal function that scales with a company on a steep trajectory, reporting directly to our AssociateGeneral Counsel (Commercial). This role will be based in the UK/EU and will play a lead role in supporting our growing UK/EU and APAC business, including our expanding presence in the UK, EU, India, Australia, and Singapore.

This is a role for a builder.

  • Design and implement scalable legal processes — standardizing deal terms, building templates, and streamlining the path to signed agreement

  • Provide clear, practical guidance on privacy, intellectual property, data security, and AI-specific legal issues as they arise

  • Navigate cross-border commercial and regulatory issues across the UK/EU and APAC and structure appropriate data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy decisions, BCRs) for our voice data processing

  • Stay ahead of the evolving legal landscape for AI technologies and their impact on customers, translating developments into actionable guidance for our teams

  • Roll up your sleeves on the full breadth of legal issues that come with being a fast-growing startup

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Value working with leadership that has tenure and a track record of success, along with A Players as cross-functional partners

  • Get energized by building systems from scratch and establishing foundational practices

  • Are very practical in addressing legal issues and allergic to unnecessary friction

  • Have an abiding spirit of idealism about your chosen profession — you’re not just closing deals, you’re building something that matters

  • Have a point of view on what good lawyering looks like and a healthy sense of humor about everything else

It’s Important To Us That You Have

  • JD, LLM, or equivalent law degree/qualification from an accredited institution and 5–12 years of experience in legal practice (or more), in-house, at a firm, or both

  • Demonstrated strength in commercial transactions internationally, particularly across UK/EU and APAC markets, across enterprise deals, partnerships, and other strategic relationships

  • Fluency in the issues that matter most to us: IP, privacy, data security, and data licensing. A successful candidate will have depth of experience in at least some of these areas, and a willingness to learn the rest.

  • Practical experience with data protection regimes relevant to our footprint and with structuring cross-border transfer mechanisms

About Andela:

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.

As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary

Strategic Partnership Manager · London, UK

Andela is hiring a London-based Strategic Partnership Manager to own and grow our co-sell partnership with GitHub, one of our most strategic technology partners, across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. GitHub is one of our highest-priority partnerships, and EMEA is where our co-sell momentum with them is strongest.

You will own the partner relationship and be accountable for the partner-sourced and

partner-influenced revenue it produces. That means building trust with GitHub's field sellers and partner team, running deal registration and co-sell, mapping accounts, and keeping our program standing current so the partner sends us more opportunities and continues to invest in us.

GitHub is the anchor, but the role is built to flex. You will work across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem, including co-sell, consumption credit and partner funding programs. As activity grows in region, you will extend the same motion to our AI lab partners. This is a revenue-generating role with a base-plus-variable compensation structure tied to partner-sourced and partner-influenced bookings.

Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the GitHub partnership in EMEA

  • Build and maintain relationships with GitHub's EMEA field sellers, partner managers, solution engineers and services leaders, so Andela is the partner they bring into accounts first.

  • Own the joint Partner Business Plan for the region, and run the QBR cadence and monthly deal reviews with GitHub.

  • Represent Andela in person at partner offices, sales kickoffs, field events and executive meetings across EMEA.

Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue

  • Source new opportunities from the partner's field organization and qualify them before bringing in Andela sales and Solutions Managers.

  • Run co-sell on live deals: connect partner sellers with Andela sellers, keep the partner informed through close, and remove blockers on both sides.

  • Map accounts with GitHub to agree on which customers we target together, then align Andela's EMEA sales team on how to pursue them.

  • Build and manage partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, with clean attribution in Salesforce.

Run deal registration, funding and program mechanics

  • Register every partner-involved opportunity so Andela receives credit for the consumption and seats we drive (for example, platform seats and cloud consumption).

  • Identify and secure deal-based partner funding, including co-investment and incentive programs, so sellers have more pricing flexibility on competitive deals.

  • Manage marketplace listings and partner program tiers: track designation and specialization requirements, certification counts, customer references and registered-deal thresholds, and file what is needed to maintain or move up a tier.

  • Maintain partner attribution tooling, such as partner portals and deal and consumption tagging.

Work across the Andela partner team

  • Bring Solutions Managers into qualified opportunities and partner enablement sessions, and relay what partner sellers need back into our offers.

  • Partner with the Partner Marketer on campaigns to partner sellers, joint customer campaigns and events, and own follow-up with partner sellers on the leads they produce.

  • Feed wins back into customer stories and references that strengthen our standing with each partner.

  • Report on partner pipeline, bookings, funding secured and program status to the Director of Partnerships and sales leadership.

Extend the motion to more partners

  • Apply the same co-sell playbook across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem in EMEA.

  • As activity grows, support our AI lab partners in region: partner seller relationships, deal registration, program tiers and marketplace presence.

How success is measured

  • Partner-sourced bookings (primary), with partner-influenced bookings credited at a lower weight.

  • Deals registered and accepted by the partner, and co-sell opportunities with a partner seller engaged.

  • Partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, and co-sell wins.

  • Partner funding secured, and partner consumption driven (platform seats, cloud consumption, AI licenses).

  • Program status: designations achieved, tier requirements met, business plans current and QBRs held on schedule.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in partner, alliance or channel management at a technology services firm, consultancy, systems integrator or ISV.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with the GitHub partner program or a comparable cloud or developer-platform partner program: co-sell, deal registration, partner portals and partner funding claims.

  • A track record of carrying a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue target and growing pipeline through a partner's field sellers.

  • Experience running joint business plans, QBRs and account mapping with a large technology partner.

  • Enough technical fluency in software development, DevOps, platform migration or AI adoption to qualify an opportunity before bringing in a solutions specialist.

  • Comfortable working through others: you influence partner sellers and internal sales teams without direct authority.

  • Strong organization and follow-through on program mechanics, with clean CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred).

  • Based in or able to work from London, and able to travel across EMEA for partner meetings and events.

Preferred

  • An existing network inside GitHub's EMEA partner and field organizations.

  • Experience managing partner tiers, designations, specializations and marketplace listings (for example, cloud marketplace listings and partner designations).

  • Exposure to AI lab partner programs, or interest in growing into them. We value candidates with a strong GitHub or cloud partner foundation who can carry that motion into newer programs.

  • Background selling or partnering on developer tooling, cloud modernization, engineering talent or technical training services.

  • Experience working across European and African markets.

  • Experience at a company building a partner function from an early stage.

Creative direction & craft

Brand

Flexible working

Diversity

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

 
 

The Role

You’ll own the operational backbone of our People function: payroll, global mobility, PEOs, commission and equity administration, HRIS, and the systems that keep everything in sync. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on clean operations, not a junior administrator position and not a People leadership seat.

You'll operate the frameworks our leadership and Finance set (pay philosophy, salary bands, commission structure, equity strategy). Your job is to implement those decisions accurately and on time, with a clear audit trail, and with the judgment to stop or escalate anything that doesn't fit the framework or lacks proper approval.

What You'll Do

  • Own payroll controls and monthly validation across UK payroll, PEOs, and other employment models, with clean reconciliation to Finance each month

  • Run visa and mobility operations end-to-end: sponsorships, relocations, compliance, right-to-work controls, and coordination with immigration advisers.

  • Manage commission review, approvals, exceptions, ns and payment accuracy each cycle; reconcile commission data between sales systems, Finance, and payroll

  • Own equity grant administration: approvals, documentation, vesting schedules, leaver events, exercises, cap table reconciliation and employee communications

  • Build and improve people workflows in Humans, Ashby and connected systems, using automation to remove manual steps from pay reviews, promotion packs, onboarding and routine queries.

  • Own onboarding, probation, employment changes, transfers, parental leave, and offboarding end-to-end: coordinate access, equipment, payroll and documentation across People, IT, Finance and hiring managers

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • 5+ years of People Operations or HR generalist experience in a scaling technology business or high-growth scaleup, with meaningful hands-on work in payroll, mobility, PEOs and benefits

  • Track record of building and running multi-country people processes from the ground up, not just maintaining existing structures.

  • Confidence owning payroll controls, global mobility operations and equity administration across multiple jurisdictions

  • Strong data literacy and experience with HRIS platforms, payroll systems and ATS integrations, with a bias toward automation over manual work

  • Clear written communicator who can produce clean documentation and audit-ready records

Valued

  • Experience independently owning multi-country payroll, mobility and equity through a scale up's growth phase.

  • Familiarity with PEO relationships, renewals and service management

  • Experience with commission administration and pooling

How We Work

We're an office-first team in London. You'll be based at our offices on Paul Street and expect to work in-office as your default. We work together because it helps us move faster, collaborate closely across Finance, IT and People, and stay sharp on detail.

This role sits at the center of trust for the whole company. We expect high standards of accuracy, timeliness and data integrity. You'll manage sensitive information and ensure payments, visas, and equity records are handled properly.

People will come to you with urgent requests and competing priorities. You need to stay organised, keep control of your workload, and know when to push back and when to escalate. This isn't a role for someone who needs a heavy process or lots of direction.

 
 

Why Wordsmith

We're scaling fast across product, commercial, and engineering, and People operations is foundational to that growth. Every new hire adds complexity to payroll, visas, benefits, and equity. Getting that right, automated, ed and audit-ready is what lets us move quickly without losing control.

This role is a key foundational hire. You'll be building the systems and processes that scale with us from ~130 people toward 300. You'll have real ownership over how the function works, and a clear seat in how we operate.

You'll report to our Head of People (or interim People leader, with a clear line to a future Head of People), work closely with Finance and leadership, and have meaningful say in how we run the function.

What you'll own

You will make sure Conduct lands and sticks inside our most strategic SAP customers. You join accounts early, shape how Conduct fits into their transformation programmes, and fully take over post-sale. You'll have a direct line from what you see in the field to what ships in the product.

  • Be the SAP brain in the room. Translate between CIOs, process owners, Basis teams and our engineers. Scope use cases across finance, supply chain, procurement and sales that land real value fast.

  • Design the transformation. Get under the skin of complex, heavily customised ECC and S/4HANA landscapes. Conceptualise where Conduct can have the biggest impact, then lead the deployment that gets the customer there.

  • Turn pilots into partnerships. Onboard hundreds of end users, prove ROI, spot expansion signals and hold the early commercial conversations that grow an account.

  • Shape the product. You'll have a direct line into product and engineering. Your view of how SAP actually runs in the real world will shape our roadmap.

  • Build the engine. Our GTM team is small and lean. You'll build the onboarding flows, tooling and reusable playbooks that let customer capacity compound without headcount growing linearly.

  • Work with our SI partners. You speak their language. Help partners deploy Conduct inside their own programmes.

No two days look the same. You'll fly out to customers when it counts and spend the rest of the time building alongside the team.

Who we hire

We're looking for people obsessed with delivering for customers. You'll fit right in if former colleagues would, without hesitating, call you one of the sharpest people they've worked with.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • 3+ years in SAP or ERP consulting, at a Big Four firm, a global SI or a specialist SAP partner. You've been on live implementations, rollouts or S/4HANA transformations, not just advisory.

  • Real depth in at least one area of SAP. Functional (FI/CO, SD, MM, PP, EWM), technical (ABAP, integration, BTP) or solution architecture. You understand how processes and custom code fit together across the landscape.

  • Client-facing confidence. You've run workshops, owned a workstream and earned the trust of senior stakeholders who were sceptical at first.

  • Commercial instinct. You notice the next problem worth solving, and you understand that a great deployment is how accounts grow.

  • Builder energy. You want to do the hands-on customer work and build the process behind it. Ambiguity excites you more than it worries you.

  • Curiosity about AI. You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to want to learn how it works and where it breaks.

  • Low ego, high self-awareness. You're comfortable saying "I don't know" in a complex technical room, then going and figuring it out.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about trajectory and sharpness than a perfect match.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Paid Search Team 👋

Our Paid Search team plays a central role in helping millions of people discover and book rail travel across Europe, the US and the UK. We manage and grow our PPC accounts across multiple markets, combining data, testing and smart use of AI to turn search insight into sustainable growth. As a Senior Paid Search Executive, you will help shape how we show up for travellers at the moment they are looking for their next journey.

You will work across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, owning campaigns from setup through to optimisation, and working closely with colleagues across Marketing, Data Science, Marketing Technology and more. Your work will have a direct impact on our European growth strategy, and you will have the space to bring your own ideas, test them and see the results.

In this role as the Senior Paid Search Executive, you will... 🚄

  • Develop, launch and scale paid search campaigns across EU markets, optimising for performance and growth

  • Support the wider Paid Search team to run go-to-market campaigns for new launches from start to finish, alongside our everyday activity

  • Deliver an always-on testing programme across ads, landing pages and other areas, and contribute to our test and learn roadmap

  • Explore and apply AI tools and automation to improve how we build, optimise and analyse campaigns

  • Analyse campaign performance and test results, turning them into clear insights and practical recommendations

  • Take ownership of your work with a high degree of autonomy, managing several priorities at once with care and attention to detail

  • Work with large data sets to spot trends, solve problems and uncover opportunities to grow our market share

  • Collaborate with colleagues across the business to share learnings, including what works well and what doesn’t, and play an important part in the success of our European growth strategy

We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • A solid understanding of digital marketing tactics, particularly how the Google auction works and automated bidding

  • Confidence working with large data sets in Excel, and a curious, data-driven approach to problem solving

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.

Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.

data.description:
Hybrid working based at one of our offices in London, Bath or Edinburgh. Your contract will be hybrid, although we don’t currently require a set number of office days. We support flexible working and trust teams to agree how and where they work best, taking a pragmatic approach based on the needs of the role and team.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

Our culture:

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.

  • Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.

  • We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

The role

As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries.

On a typical day you will…

  • Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams

  • Design, implement and operate your services within your domain

  • Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements

  • Maintain and extend documentation for your services

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate

  • Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers

  • Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

What you need…

  • To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.

  • We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.

  • Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.

  • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.

  • Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.

  • Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.

  • Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.

  • Willing to be on-call for your services.

Core technical skills you must have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js, specifically TypeScript

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with Serverless products

  • Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB

  • Experience mentoring engineers

  • Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model

  • Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management

  • Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:

  • Talent screen - 30 min intro call with our Talent partner or an Engineering manager

  • Bar raiser - 40 min with two Engineering leaders focused on Engineering culture alignment

  • Technical loop - 2h virtual technical assessment with 2 core components - system design, TypeScript code review with breaks between the stages. You will receive preparation materials for the round and more information on how to prepare.

Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l'obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main.

En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront :

- Automatiser les mesures simulables : injection de mesures en dblib côté firmware, synchronisation réelle, vérification dans l'app.

- Explorer l'émulation de device : étudier et prototyper la simulation complète d'un produit sur Raspberry Pi (comportement BLE/Wi-Fi, cycle d'installation, génération de mesures)

- Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation)

- Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumentation série, lecture de l'état des dispositifs (écran, LED).

- Développer et maintenir les scripts d'automatisation en Python (Appium, pytest) qui orchestrent app mobile (iOS et Android), backend et instrumentation physique.

- Intégrer chaque nouveau scénario à la CI Jenkins pour qu'il tourne chaque nuit, et mesurer la réduction du volume de tests manuels qu'il permet.

- Travailler avec les outils d'aujourd'hui : l'équipe développe avec un harness d'agents de code (Claude Code…) — pipeline de génération de tests, revues assistées ; vous l'utiliserez et contribuerez à l'améliorer.

- Analyser les résultats, remonter les bugs et documenter les composants hardware et software ; participer aux revues de code.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) et recherchez un stage de fin d'études ;
  • Une excellente maîtrise de Python est indispensable, notamment pour l'automatisation et l'interfaçage avec le hardware (ex : pyserial) ;
  • Des connaissances en conception mécanique et/ou en impression 3D (ex : FreeCAD, Fusion 360, Cura) seraient un atout majeur — le jig est autant mécanique que logiciel ;
  • Des bases en électronique (schémas simples, capteurs, relais, UART) seraient un plus ;
  • Une curiosité pour les agents de code (Claude Code, Codex…) est un plus ;
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les environnements MacOS et Linux ;
  • Vous êtes passionné.e par les produits high-tech innovants, l'IoT et les enjeux de la qualité logicielle et hardware ;
  • Vous êtes curieux.se, rigoureux.se, autonome, force de proposition et vous disposez d'une bonne capacité d'adaptation pour progresser dans un environnement en constante évolution ;
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer vos idées et travailler en équipe ;
  • Vous maîtrisez l'anglais technique (lecture et écriture de code et de documentation).

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
  • Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !


Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

Dans le cadre de la migration de notre application desktop, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire pour piloter le suivi de l’adoption et accompagner nos clients tout au long de leur transition vers la nouvelle solution.

L’objectif sera de permettre au plus grand nombre de clients de migrer dans les meilleures conditions avant le transfert progressif du suivi à notre équipe Support, à l’issue du stage.

Ce stage combine gestion de projet, communication client, accompagnement au changement, analyse de données et compréhension des environnements informatiques hospitaliers.

Tes missions

Piloter la communication autour de la migration

Tu construiras et déploieras un plan de communication adapté aux différentes étapes de la migration :

  • Identification des clients à contacter et segmentation des populations ;

  • Préparation des messages de premier contact ;

  • Organisation des relances et suivi des réponses ;

  • Adaptation des communications selon le niveau d’avancement des clients ;

  • Gestion des objections, questions et éventuels points de blocage ;

  • Formalisation des bonnes pratiques et des argumentaires.

Prioriser les migrations

Tu contribueras à définir une stratégie de priorisation des clients en fonction de différents critères :

  • Taille et typologie des établissements ;

  • Niveau de maturité ou de préparation technique ;

  • Contraintes liées à l’environnement informatique ;

  • Niveau d’engagement et de réponse des interlocuteurs ;

  • Risques identifiés et complexité de l’accompagnement nécessaire.

L’objectif sera de concentrer les efforts sur les clients présentant le meilleur potentiel de progression ou nécessitant un accompagnement spécifique.

Mettre en place un tableau de suivi et des outils de reporting

Tu concevras et maintiendras un tableau de bord permettant de suivre l’avancement global de la migration, notamment :

  • Nombre de clients contactés ;

  • Taux de réponse et de relance ;

  • Clients migrés, en cours de migration ou non encore engagés ;

  • Principales raisons de blocage ;

  • Actions réalisées et prochaines étapes ;

  • Indicateurs d’adoption et d’utilisation.

Tu t’appuieras notamment sur Mixpanel et sur les outils internes disponibles afin de fiabiliser le suivi et de produire des reportings réguliers à destination des équipes concernées.

Accompagner les clients

Selon les besoins identifiés, tu pourras également participer directement à l’accompagnement des clients :

  • Réponse aux questions liées à la migration ;

  • Coordination avec les équipes techniques et Support ;

  • Aide à la préparation des étapes de migration ;

  • Suivi des situations nécessitant un accompagnement personnalisé ;

  • Remontée des irritants et des besoins récurrents ;

  • Contribution à l’amélioration continue du parcours de migration.

Préparer le transfert à l’équipe Support

Une partie importante du stage consistera à préparer la reprise du suivi par l’équipe Support :

  • Documentation du processus de migration ;

  • Centralisation de l’historique et du statut de chaque client ;

  • Formalisation des procédures et réponses types ;

  • Identification des cas particuliers et des risques résiduels ;

  • Transmission des outils, méthodes et indicateurs de pilotage.

Profil recherché

Tu es étudiant.e en école d’ingénieur ou en formation supérieure spécialisée en informatique, systèmes et réseaux, gestion de projet ou domaine équivalent.

Tu disposes idéalement de connaissances en :

  • Administration système et réseau ;

  • Environnements informatiques d’entreprise ;

  • Analyse et suivi de données ;

  • Gestion de projet ou conduite du changement ;

  • Outils de reporting et d’analyse produit, notamment Mixpanel.

Une première compréhension des systèmes d’information hospitaliers serait un véritable plus.

Nous recherchons surtout une personne :

  • Structurée et organisée ;

  • À l’aise dans les échanges avec des interlocuteurs variés ;

  • Capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle ;

  • Curieuse et autonome ;

  • Dotée d’un bon esprit d’analyse ;

  • À l’aise pour formaliser, synthétiser et suivre des plans d’action ;

Ce que tu apprendras

Ce stage te permettra de développer une expérience concrète sur :

Informations pratiques

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🔥 Our Business Operations team

At Joko, the Business Operations team is the powerhouse behind internal innovation. We tackle the company’s most strategic and complex challenges and we don’t just solve them, we turn them into long-term, scalable growth engines. Whether it's launching entirely new business lines, rethinking revenue infrastructure, or embedding AI into our operations, we lead high-impact initiatives that push Joko forward faster, smarter, and stronger.

Our mission: Help Joko operate at its absolute best, every single day.

🦾 The role in one sentence

Security is Joko’s number one priority, and you will own it where it touches every employee: from every laptop to every identity and tool. You turn the initiatives already underway into a secure-by-design, automated foundation, so a fast-growing, AI-driven company can move fast, safely.

🎯 Context

Joko is the AI shopping app that helps millions of people save time and money: 7 million users, 10,000 merchants and a team of ~120 people from 18 nationalities, heading to 200+ by the end of 2027. Enterprise-grade security (SSO, MFA, audits) is one of our six company-wide priorities for 2026, and our internal IT foundation needs to scale with us: identity management, device management, business tooling, and endpoint security. This is a rare chance to own that foundation at a pivotal moment, with a blank canvas to build on and a company-wide priority behind you. This role sits at the intersection of IT Ops and security — a cross-functional role that touches everyone in the company.

🚀 Your missions

1. IT foundation & identities

  • Set up an Identity Provider (company-wide SSO, plus SCIM for access lifecycle management), and own the password manager while ensuring MFA is activated wherever possible.

  • Make access zero-touch: our goal is to connect most of our tools to the Identity Provider so access is granted and removed automatically. You build the integrations and automations (SSO, SCIM, low-code workflows) that make it happen.

  • Deploy an MDM solution for centralised device management (device fleet, configuration, compliance).

  • Review our company tooling catalogue: make sure everyone has the minimum access they need, and that security audits are up to date.

2. Security of the working environment

  • Drive security best practices for the working environment (endpoint hardening, access management, ongoing team awareness such as training and phishing simulations).

  • Be the go-to owner of the security of our employees' working environment.

  • Security review of new tools: run the security audit on every new tool, including AI tools, and on any new way of using the tools we already have, before it is rolled out.

  • Own the AI security policy: define, maintain and promote Joko’s AI security policy.

3. Day-to-day run

  • Access management: With tool owners, manage access across our stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Keeper, AI tools, business SaaS): permissions, roles, reviews, onboarding, offboarding and external users. Your mission: automate today’s largely manual processes and make them as efficient as possible.

  • Security alert & incident management: monitor, triage and handle alerts from our identity, device and endpoint security tools, and act as first responder on incidents affecting the working environment (compromised account, lost device, phishing, malware alert). Build and maintain incident response playbooks, and run post-incident reviews so we keep improving.

  • Fleet management: In collaboration with the people team, device onboarding and offboarding.

  • First-line employee support: helping colleagues with technical questions related to our tools.

💚 Why you'll love this role

  • Build, don't just maintain: you choose, deploy and shape the IdP, MDM and EDR stack from day one.

  • Real ownership and visibility: your work is felt by every employee, every day, and directly supports one of the company's top priorities.

  • A pioneering topic: help define how we safely adopt AI agents and AI-powered workflows, in a company where everyone uses AI daily.

  • A company on the rise: 7M users, 10k merchants, and a team growing from ~120 to 200+ — with a strong international, partly remote culture.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • A builder at heart: you automate everything you can, and you’d rather build a tool or workflow than repeat a manual task. Showing you’ve built and automated things matters as much as your previous experience in IT & Security.

  • Solid IT fundamentals (identities, device management, endpoint security, enterprise SaaS tooling), gained over ~4-7 years in IT Ops, security or systems administration.

  • Strong cross-functional communication: able to gather context from business teams and translate security stakes into plain language.

  • Rigor, autonomy, and a taste for building clear, durable processes.

  • Open and eager to learn on emerging topics — notably AI agents and their security — and excited to help build this area from the ground up.

✨ What would make the difference (nice to have)

  • Experience with an enterprise EDR / anti-malware.

  • Awareness of security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001…).

  • Hands-on experience deploying an IdP (Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID…) and/or an MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Intune…).

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

💰 Our Finance team

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, each with its own ressources. Today, the team consists of 2 people but are actively recruiting toward a target organization of 7. Most of it is still to be hired and built — by you. You will report to Quentin, our COO.

✨ Why this role is special

  • You build the function instead of inheriting it. The target organization — FP&A, Finance Operations, Procurement — exists on paper and almost nothing of it is built. You recruit the team, set the standards, and decide how Finance operates for the next stage of the company. The role is designed to grow into VP Finance once the function is in place.

  • You get a genuinely 360 scope. Planning, accounting close, cash, financing, multi-entity structuring, procurement, and investor relations all sit with you — across multiple business lines, in France, Spain, and the US, with more markets coming. Very few finance leaders get that full surface at this stage.

  • You join a profitable company that is moving fast. Joko is already profitable and keeps growing quickly, with new business lines and countries opening. You build a finance function for a company on the offensive, not one managing a slowdown.

  • You sit at the table where the decisions are made. You partner directly with the COO and the co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, and business line priorities, with the numbers you built as the basis of the discussion.

🎯 What you will do

This is a builder role. We are looking for a finance leader who runs the core of Finance hands-on today and builds the team that will run it tomorrow. Over the next two years, your mandate is to recruit the people the function is missing, set up the three poles, and put in place the processes that let you step back from the day-to-day.

We prefer to say it upfront: if what excites you is leading a team that already exists, this is not the role. If you want to build one on solid foundations and grow with it, it is a great one.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and lead the Finance team: manage and develop the current 2 team, recruit the next hires across FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, and set how the team works;

  • Own planning and reporting: budget, forecast, and actuals vs. budget across all business lines (Online, Card-Linked, Gift Cards) and geographies. Our modeling combines elasticity-based CAC projections, cohort-based revenue models, and granular bottom-up cost budgets — you will own it, keep improving it.

  • Run the accounting close and controls: monthly and annual closing with our external accountants across France, Spain, and the US, the audit of our financial statements, and robust controls to prevent fraud and errors. Build toward group consolidation under international standards (IFRS) as entities are added;

  • Manage cash and financing: day-to-day cash visibility, Gift Cards working capital, multi-currency flows, and our relationships with banks and financing partners. Cash is king — make sure the whole company knows it;

  • Structure a multi-entity group: how our entities are organized, intercompany flows, transfer pricing, cost allocation, and local compliance as we open new countries;

  • Be the financial voice at the leadership table: partner with the COO and co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, pricing, and business line priorities;

  • Support investor relations: investor model, financial reporting, and fundraising preparation;

  • Drive cost efficiency: work with budget owners on their targets and negotiate key supplier contracts;

  • Do the work, with AI: you will be a high-level individual contributor as much as a manager. We expect you to use AI to automate repetitive work (reporting, reconciliation, data extraction) and augment analysis, so a lean team operates like a much larger one;

  • Coordinate with external partners: accountants, auditors, and financial advisors.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 10+ years of experience combining traditional finance (audit, transaction services, corporate finance, investment banking, or private equity) and finance in a high-growth tech company or scale-up. Ideally, you have done several cycles in companies at a stage close to ours.

  • Breadth: You have worked hands-on on at least two of the three pillars of a finance function: FP&A and business projection, accounting / financial control / cash, and financing / structuring / procurement. You are a 360 finance profile, not a specialist of one area.

  • Ownership: You have run a finance function, or a large part of one, end to end, and you have led or coordinated a team. You are ready to build a bigger one.

  • Team builder: You have hired and developed finance people yourself, and you know what good looks like when you interview for FP&A, accounting, or procurement profiles.

  • Hands-on builder: You are eager to build things yourself — models, closing processes, reporting packs — not only review them, and you have the drive to put in the work during the build phase.

  • Learning speed: You understand a new business fast, and you can explain its key mechanics clearly to demanding stakeholders, including co-founders and investors.

  • Strategic mindset: You think like a business partner, not just a finance controller, and you are comfortable challenging leadership with data-backed recommendations.

  • Operational rigor: You are structured, data-driven, and detail-oriented, with a talent for spotting flaws and building processes that prevent them.

  • AI-native mindset: You use AI tools in your work today and have a practical point of view on how they change the finance function.

  • Languages: You are fluent in English (the main language we use internally). French is a plus but not mandatory

🤝 Our hiring process

You might also be invited to meet other team members at the office for a coffee or a drink!

💎 Our perks

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

About the role

You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process.

Responsibilities

  • Administer SSO, the directory and the password manager. Handle onboarding and offboarding, and run regular access reviews.

  • Manage the Mac fleet: setup, MDM policies, OS and app updates, and keeping the endpoint security agent installed and working.

  • Apply the security baselines and access policies the security team defines, and keep our tools configured to match.

  • Administer our SaaS tools: setup, admin access and licences. Handle the IT side of bringing on new vendors.

  • Support the security team during incidents by isolating devices, revoking access and pulling logs.

  • Provide evidence for IT controls during audits.

  • Automate repetitive work such as onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and evidence collection.

  • Write and maintain documentation for IT procedures.

  • Take part in IT on-call.

Definition of success

  • 1 month: handles onboarding, offboarding and day-to-day account and device work without help, and knows how our tools are set up.

  • End of probation: owns our identity, device and SaaS setup, has automated at least one process that used to be manual, and is the person the security team goes to for IT changes and incident support.

  • 12 months: runs corporate IT independently. Onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and audit evidence mostly run on tooling they built.

Experience

  • 5+ years in IT, systems engineering or IT security.

  • Hands-on admin experience with an enterprise identity provider, an MDM and endpoint security tools.

  • Strong macOS management: configuration profiles, privacy preference and system extension policies.

  • Writes Python or Bash to automate work. Infrastructure as code is a plus.

  • Has supported a SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit.

  • Knows crypto companies are frequent targets of phishing and social engineering, and sets up systems with that in mind. Web3 or fintech experience is a plus.

  • Writes clear documentation.

  • Prefers simple setups people follow over perfect ones they work around.

  • Comfortable being part of an on-call rotation.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Vos missions

Vous travaillerez au cœur de l'équipe pentest pour réaliser des audits, évaluer les vulnérabilités et améliorer la posture de sécurité de nos clients, tout en prenant progressivement la main sur la structuration et la croissance de l'activité.

Concrètement :

  • Réaliser des audits de sécurité et tests d'intrusion (Web, Active Directory, Mobile, IoT…)

Le périmètre s'ajuste selon votre profil et vos ambitions : plus vous voulez prendre, plus il y a à prendre.

Vos compétences

Vous avez déjà une expérience solide en pentest et :

  • Maîtrise des outils de pentest et de leurs limites
